scope: Generated direct DIMSTYLE table-writer allocation rollback, same-codec retry, typed readback, and referenced TEXTSTYLE handle closure across supported DXF revisions.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored DRW_Dimstyle and DRW_Textstyle generated during each test run
source.profile: One custom DIMSTYLE with generated text, scale, arrow size, precision, text placement and a group-340 reference to one emitted Standard TEXTSTYLE.

implementation.method: Emit the referenced TEXTSTYLE before direct writeDimstyle(); calibrate callback allocation count; inject std::bad_alloc at each measured DIMSTYLE callback allocation; require failure and destination-sentinel plus caller-row preservation; retry with the same codec; compare exact bytes with clean output; and freshly read back both rows, including group-340 handle resolution.

validation.directControl: build/tests/libdxfrw_dimstyle_table_allocation_tests: PASS; seven revisions, both encodings, all 145 measured offsets

limitations: Generated writer transaction and typed readback evidence only; producer interoperability and native dimension semantics are not qualified.
One DIMSTYLE profile does not cover all legacy/modern dimension-variable combinations, downgrade cases, optional reference combinations, or native rendering.
Does not implement LibreCAD PR #3269's adapter-side reconciliation of edited LC_LineType definitions against archived DRW_LType records.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
